_blind_means: Each of the five seats was given the pinned sha, the document path, and ONLY its own slice of the P1 list — no authorship, no round history, no sight of another seat's slice, and no statement of which verdict the programme would prefer. Every seat was instructed to REFUTE BY DEFAULT: the verdict is `already_fixed` unless the seat can quote the offending text as it stands at the pinned commit.
seat: five verification seats, partitioned 1-4 / 5-7 / 8-10 / 11-13 / 14-16 over the round-3 P1 list
_verdict_note: ⛔⛔ THE HEADLINE IS THE STALENESS, NOT THE DEFECTS. Of 16 recorded P1s, ONE PAIR WAS THE SAME DEFECT (#1 and #13 both name §2.5's 'printed beside every pooled figure'), so 15 were distinct; FOUR of those were ALREADY FIXED at the pinned commit (#2, #4, #12, #16) and would have been re-applied or re-litigated by a cycle that inherited the list as a summary. ⭐ A fifth (#9) verified TRUE on the merits when the seat ran the check the finding asserted could not be run: all six pairwise author-list intersections are empty, and the complete lists were already committed on `main` in three artifacts nobody had pointed the reader at. That reclassifies it from a claim-integrity defect to a provenance one, at a materially lower weight than it was filed at. ⛔ TEN of the sixteen findings CARRIED A FACTUAL ERROR OF THEIR OWN (`old_finding_accurate: false`) — wrong counts, wrong sections, wrong direction, line numbers drifted — which is the measured case for re-deriving rather than inheriting: a review finding is evidence with a date on it, exactly like any other reading.

method.why_not_a_fresh_lens: paper-hardening §8a. Rounds 1-3 went 3 -> 2 -> 9 blockers. A rising count under fresh lenses tracks how many unexamined surfaces each round introduces, not how many defects the paper holds.
method.instrument_context: The coverage census (`claim_coverage.py`) scored this document at 46/259 sentences read by any instrument on 2026-08-26 — 213 uncovered. That census is the enumeration this round was told to start from; re-deriving the standing P1s came first because a stale finding list poisons every round built on it.
method.convergence: Seats A and D, given disjoint slices and no sight of each other, landed on the SAME §2.5 defect from opposite directions (#1 'the declared substitute is not delivered', #13 'the universality claim is false'). Independent convergence across a partition boundary is the strongest signal this arrangement produces, and it decided the fix: PRINT the missing ranges rather than soften the rule.
